name: Dominoes: All Fives
author: Simon Holmes (filmote) & Stephance C (vampirics); Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
license: BSD-3-Clause (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)
description: Dominoes 'All Fives' by Filmote and Vampirics: the popular dominoes variant where you score when the open ends of the layout add up to five or a multiple of five.

descriptions.en: Dominoes 'All Fives' by Filmote and Vampirics: the popular dominoes variant where you score when the open ends of the layout add up to five or a multiple of five.
descriptions.it: Dominoes 'All Fives' di Filmote e Vampirics: la variante del domino in cui si fa punto quando le estremità aperte della fila sommano cinque o un multiplo di cinque.
